subject: Achievements
text: Players can always go back to a previous chapter from the File select screen, so achievements are not missable.

evidence.quote: You can always go back to a previous chapter on the File select screen, so achievements are not missable.

subject: Sprite movement
text: Compared to its predecessor, the game lets the player move the sprite diagonally, which a commenter found enjoyable.

evidence.quote: the gameplay improved a lot from its predecessor, being able to move your sprite diagonally now made the experience very enjoyable

subject: Jack of All Trades
text: A commenter says the Jack of All Trades achievement is definitely missable.

subject: Dagger
text: A commenter says they skipped getting it here, got it from Cleopatra, and the achievement still popped.

evidence.quote: I skipped getting it here and got it from Cleopatra (as I usually did as a kid) and this still popped for me.

subject: Jack of All Trades
